text: I feel a sense of anticipation mixed with restlessness. The repetition in the words, "It's still a little bit," mirrors the meticulous adjustments happening around me. In this environment—a blend of office and exhibition—there is a striving for balance and perfection, yet also an awareness that true evenness may always remain just out of reach. The colorful display and corporate atmosphere evoke curiosity and a subtle tension between creativity and order.
